feature_name: Enhanced Mermaid Editor with CodeMirror Integration
description: Implement an improved Mermaid diagram editor in the TTD dialog that replaces the basic textarea with CodeMirror for better editing experience. Additionally, enhance the Mermaid-to-Excalidraw conversion logic to handle text wrapping and subgraph styling more effectively, and introduce a client-side auto-fix mechanism for invalid Mermaid syntax as a beta feature.
functional_requirements: Replace the existing textarea editor in the TTD dialog with CodeMirror, ensuring it's excluded from service worker pre-caching and gracefully falls back to a textarea when CodeMirror is unavailable.
Improve the Mermaid parsing and conversion logic to properly handle text wrapping within diagram elements and apply correct styling to subgraphs.
Implement a client-side auto-fix feature that attempts to automatically correct common invalid Mermaid syntax errors, marking this functionality as BETA in the UI.
